title: Delaware Education Job Watch
only_added_rule: Cost and repeat-work control: Before detailed suitability analysis, compare retrieved listings with verified prior reported listings actually accessible to this task, using stable vacancy ID, official URL, posted/modified date and relevant fields. Skip repeat detailed analysis and notification for unchanged listings; reassess only new or materially changed listings. Reuse verified pages already fetched within the same run. Preserve the existing search scope, candidate criteria, frequency and destination. A failed or partial source read is an availability hold, never evidence of no new jobs or a closed vacancy. Preserve previous fingerprints; do not invent prior results or treat missing history as an empty history. Record source, observation date and coverage for later comparisons.
